name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: A row that passes by without end, and stops when you look closely.
use: Content a reader may glance at and lose nothing by missing: the names of customers, short praise, a ticker. Write the row twice and hide the second copy from assistive technology.

instead.when: A reader must find, compare or act on the items

classes.name: marquee
classes.description: The row: it clips, fades both ends with a mask and stops on hover and focus. Give it role="group" and a label

classes.name: marquee-reverse
classes.description: The row passes the other way, for the second of two rows

classes.name: marquee-track
classes.description: One copy of the row, at least as wide as the marquee; write it twice, the second with aria-hidden="true"

states.name: paused
states.description: Or :focus-within: the row stops while the pointer is over it or focus is inside it

states.name: copy
states.description: The second copy, for the eye only; with reduced motion it is removed and the first track wraps onto centered lines

properties.name: --marquee-duration
properties.description: Time for one copy to pass

properties.name: --marquee-gap
properties.description: Space between items, and between the copies

properties.name: --marquee-fade
properties.description: Length of the fade at each end
